name: com.lingkyn.locomotion.core
description: Engine-light locomotion and comfort substrate: a closed set of locomotion mode identities and an open anchor identity sharing one canonical form, a closed typed comfort policy (vignette, turn mode, turn increment, movement speed, posture) with fail-closed rejection, teleport/turn/move intents applied to an immutable locomotion state with an anchor registry, deterministic replay with a fingerprint, and structured results with stable failure codes.

samples.description: Domain-only walkthrough of the comfort policy, anchor registry, and a replayed teleport/turn/move intent sequence; needs no scene.
